Found it. The law is exactly linear in both inputs: sigma/100 MPa = 0.184·T² − 1.21·ε, with ε in percent and T in units of 100 K.

Training NMSE is about 6e-24, which is at machine precision, so the form is right. The fitted constants are 0.184 and 1.21, printed to three significant figures.
